messages:
Maria (docs): Quick heads-up — I ran the link-checker against the Dedicated Provisioning guide and it flagged ~6 broken anchors and 1 outdated SDK snippet that still uses the v1 client. I can open a small PR but want to check backcompat wording and a tiny autoscale example first.

link-checker-bot: Automated report: 6 anchor failures, 1 deprecated SDK usage detected. Results: https://ci.internal/reports/link-check/1779001233 (summary attached) :mag:

Liam (eng): Can you paste the broken anchor names here? I can patch anchors + redirects this afternoon.

Maria (docs): Sure — broken anchors: 1) #tenant-onboarding-flow 2) #reserved-pools-usage 3) #burst-policy-examples 4) #isolation-labels 5) #rollback-guidance 6) #autoscale-yaml-samples. The SDK sample is under "Provisioning > SDK snippets" and still shows `from redwood import ClientV1`.

Rahul (infra): ^ those anchors were moved during the handbook split; we left old ids in a few include files. Best to add HTML redirects for compatibility, but also update the includes. I can put a redirect patch in the infra-docs repo.

Maria (docs): Proposed backcompat blurb for the SDK note: "If you're migrating from SDK v1, note that Dedicated provisioning client methods were renamed in v2; we include a side-by-side example below. Existing configs continue to work for a 90‑day transition window." Thoughts?

Sam (product): +1 to a short, visible note. Can we also include a minimal autoscale example consumers can copy? Engineers often ask for the smallest working example.

Maria (docs): Draft autoscale YAML (intended to live in examples/autoscale/minimal.yaml):
```yaml
scalePolicy:
  mode: target_utilization
  target_utilization_pct: 70
  cooldown_seconds: 60
  min_instances: 1
  max_instances: 8
```
And an SDK v2 quick snippet (Python):
```python
# using redwood-sdk v2
from redwood import ProvisioningClient
client = ProvisioningClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
policy = {"scalePolicy": {"mode": "target_utilization", "target_utilization_pct": 70}}
client.update_tenant_scale(tenant_id="t-123", policy=policy)
```
Also a one-liner for typescript users: `await client.tenants.updateScale("t-123", policy)`

Liam (eng): That Python snippet looks good. Add a comment mentioning the param name change from `autoscale` -> `scalePolicy` so it's clear. Also, remove the hardcoded key and point to env var in docs.

Maria (docs): Good catch — updated snippet in my branch. I'll include a tiny migration table: v1 field -> v2 field.

Rahul (infra): I'll open the redirect PR for the moved anchors (infra-docs). Maria, if you push the docs PR I can link the redirect PR in it so reviewers see the full fix.

Maria (docs): Done — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821 — includes anchor fixes, updated snippets, backcompat paragraph, and the minimal autoscale YAML in examples. Please review when you have a moment.

Liam (eng): Reviewing now, should be quick. If nobody objects I'll merge after a quick pass. :thumbsup:

Sam (product): Thanks — will QA with a quick smoke (apply the YAML to a staging tenant) once merged.

link-checker-bot: Re-run scheduled after PR merge to verify resolved anchors.

Maria (docs): Thanks all — tagging @Liam for final review and @Rahul for the redirect PR pairing.

Liam (eng): Reviewing in ~30.

Rahul (infra): I'll drop the redirect PR link in the docs PR comments.

Maria (docs): Appreciate it — closing the thread after merge.
